svg.font-family: 'DM Sans', Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Flutter Developer roadmap
svg.desc: 01 Mobile Platforms and Design: iOS and Android, The app lifecycle, Mobile accessibility, Permissions and privacy, Mobile security basics; 02 Dart: Dart basics, Null safety, Asynchronous Dart, Modern Dart features, Packages, analysis and formatting; 03 Flutter Fundamentals: Projects, devices and hot reload, Widgets, Layout, Lists, Themes, images and dark mode, Flutter DevTools; 04 State and Data Flow: Widget state, App architecture, State management with Riverpod, Server data and caching, Other state packages; 05 Navigation: Navigation basics, Routes with go_router, Tabs, Redirects for signed-in screens, Deep links, App links and universal links; 06 Forms and Input: Text fields, The keyboard and focus, Validation, Autofill, Accessible forms, Form packages; 07 Working with APIs: Changing data, Handling API errors, Poor and missing networks, Tokens on the device, Rendering user content safely, Configuration and environments; 08 Device Features: Plugins and native code, Sharing and opening links, Offline reading, Notifications, Camera and photos; 09 Testing: Unit tests, Widget tests, Testing API calls, Integration tests, Accessibility testing, Testing in continuous integration; 10 Performance and Release: Measuring performance, App size, Builds, flavours and signing, Obfuscation and debug symbols, Store requirements, Over-the-air updates, Crash reporting and security checks
svg.text: Every topic has a guide in the stage pages next to this image.
